name: @bats-lang/capacitor-google-authorize
description: Google authorization on Android with no sign-in: Play services' AuthorizationClient, shaped as Flutter's google_sign_in authorization client

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc && rollup --config rollup.config.mjs && docgen --api GoogleAuthorizePlugin --output-readme README.md --output-json dist/docs.json
